clue.text: Higgins's job (referring to Eliza as a sweetie)

definitions.text: Higgins's job (referring to Eliza as a sweetie)

parts.note: surface reading: Professor Higgins in Shaw's Pygmalion polishing the speech and manners of the flower girl Eliza Doolittle

parts.words: referring to Eliza as a sweetie
parts.note: setter's reading: if Eliza is a sweetie, a sugary thing, then polishing her is processing a sweetener

explanation.surface: A note on what Professor Higgins does to Eliza in Pygmalion, with an affectionate aside.
explanation.walkthrough: Higgins refines Eliza; call her 'sugar' and his work becomes an industrial process.
explanation.definitionFit: The industrial purification of raw cane or beet into white crystals is exactly what the phrase names.

clue.text: His extraordinary tales will be out of this world

definitions.text: His extraordinary tales will be out of this world

parts.words: His extraordinary tales will be out of this world
parts.note: surface reading: a storyteller whose yarns are amazing, out of this world meaning wonderful
setter's reading: taken literally, his stories happen beyond Earth because he journeys among the planets

explanation.surface: Praise for a raconteur whose stories are astonishing.
explanation.definitionFit: An astronaut or voyager through the cosmos literally goes beyond our planet, so his travel tales are literally unearthly.

clue.text: Ideas in embryo for minimal weapons of war?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: rudimentary beginnings of thoughts, as in the germ of an idea
second meaning: microbes, tiny agents used in biological warfare

explanation.surface: Half-formed notions about very small arms.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second sense: bacteria are the smallest weapons there are.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the seed or starting point of a notion and microscopic organisms causing disease.

clue.text: Mutineer takes pride in uprisings

parts.note: a mutineer is one who rebels
a pride is a group of lions

explanation.surface: A mutineer glories in revolts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pride' looks like the feeling but is the collective noun for big cats.
explanation.definitionFit: Revolts against authority are risings up, the plural noun naming such acts of revolt.

clue.text: Oriental appears to hold the first of these values

parts.note: E for east, the oriental direction

indicators.note: to hold something is to have it inside, so one piece sits within another

parts.note: to appear is to seem

indicators.note: the first of a word asks for just its opening letter

parts.note: opening letter of these

explanation.surface: An Eastern person seems to hold certain principles first.
explanation.walkthrough: E then SEEMS with T inserted after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: To value someone is to hold them in high regard, a verb in the same third-person form.

clue.text: Tend to give a rise?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to tend to do something is to be ... to it
second meaning: to slope upwards, as a road or hill does

explanation.surface: Asks whether one is inclined to grant a pay increase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give a rise' suggests a pay rise; here it is a gradient.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means both have a tendency and lean or slope upwards like a hillside.

clue.text: Part of foot appearing to move slowly

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a twelfth of a foot in imperial length
second meaning: to creep forward bit by bit

explanation.surface: Some part of the foot seems to creep along.
explanation.walkthrough: The foot is the unit of measure, not the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve of these small units make up a foot, and the verb means to edge forward gradually.

clue.text: Gaiety nil, though oddly a kindly spirit

indicators.note: oddly means in a strange fashion, so the letters come out in an unusual order

parts.note: both words used letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone with no cheerfulness who is, oddly, still kind at heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Friendliness and warm good nature amount to a cheerful benevolent disposition.

clue.text: Characteristic of the spirit of noel

definitions.text: Characteristic of the spirit of noel

parts.note: surface reading: the Christmas spirit, as if describing a festive ghost or the mood of the holiday
setter's reading: the quality that marks the season's mood is gay cheerfulness

explanation.surface: A description of what marks the Christmas spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: Merry light-heartedness and joyful cheer are what the festive season is supposed to bring.

clue.text: Fair description of the skill of certain pyramid builders

definitions.text: Fair description of the skill of certain pyramid builders

parts.note: surface reading: the ancient Egyptians and their great stone tombs
setter's reading: circus performers who stand on each other's shoulders to form a human pyramid

explanation.surface: An assessment of the skills of those who built the pyramids.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fair' hints at the funfair or circus where human pyramids are formed.
explanation.definitionFit: Gymnastic tumbling skill is what a troupe needs to balance on one another's shoulders.

clue.text: Waterway painter to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent means only partly, so just a portion of the name is used

parts.note: the Venetian painter famed for his views of the city

explanation.surface: A painter who depicted waterways, to a degree.
explanation.walkthrough: Canaletto loses his last four letters; fittingly he painted Venetian canals.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificial channel cut for boats is a man-made waterway.

clue.text: Constable's put-up Job ?

parts.note: surface reading: a policeman's frame-up, a crime staged to incriminate someone
setter's reading: John Constable the painter, and the stand he set up to hold his canvas

explanation.surface: A police officer accused of framing someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Constable is the English landscape painter; the thing he put up was his picture stand.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter's wooden stand for a canvas is set up wherever he works.

clue.text: Arrange for season's return

indicators.note: a return goes back the way it came, so the word is read from the end

parts.note: tide means season, as in Christmastide

explanation.surface: Planning for a seasonal homecoming.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepare text for publication, ordering and correcting it, is a way of arranging it.

clue.text: Western Isle singer

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for western
an ait is a small river island

explanation.surface: A vocalist from the Western Isles of Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: Waits were bands of street carol singers at Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically, groups of carollers going door to door at Christmas were known by this name.

clue.text: We hear song-writer delivering what sounds like great stuff

definitions.text: delivering what sounds like great stuff

indicators.note: what we hear is spoken, so the name is taken by its sound alone

parts.note: the American composer of Anything Goes

explanation.surface: A songwriter producing what seem to be great songs.
explanation.walkthrough: In the definition, 'great stuff' sounds like grate stuff: fuel for the fireplace.
explanation.definitionFit: A coal porter carries sacks of fuel for household fires to the door.

clue.text: Stays to reorganize the seminar

indicators.note: to reorganize is to put in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word seminar used letter for letter; 'the' is filler for the surface

explanation.surface: Staying behind to rearrange a seminar.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay is to remain, both verbs in the third-person singular form.

clue.text: Create oblong garment as temporary expedient

parts.note: to create is to make
a shift is a straight loose dress

explanation.surface: Instructions to sew a long dress as a stopgap.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopgap arrangement used until something better is found is a makeshift.

clue.text: Note incentive that's getting us worked up

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase: describing something that stirs feelings

parts.note: E is a musical note
an incentive is a motive

explanation.surface: A spur to action that has us excited.
explanation.definitionFit: Language or subjects that arouse strong feelings and stir people are described by this adjective.

clue.text: Raiders who came against one college

parts.note: V for versus
Roman numeral one
King's College, at Cambridge or London

explanation.surface: Attackers who came up against a single college.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norse seafarers who plundered the coasts of Europe were notorious marauders.

clue.text: On balance moral doubt has little effect
Some call it hunting

parts.note: surface reading: some people call it hunting, as if debating the name of a blood sport
setter's reading: some call, it being hunting: a cry used in the chase

explanation.surface: A remark that some people refer to the sport as hunting.
explanation.definitionFit: Huntsmen shout this cry when the fox is sighted, urging the hounds on.

clue.text: Place for back-seat driver when aunt is out with one

indicators.note: out suggests disorder, letters knocked out of place

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Where the back-seat driver sits when Auntie takes someone for a drive.
explanation.walkthrough: A tonneau is the rear passenger section of an open car.
explanation.definitionFit: The rear passenger compartment of an old open motor car is where back-seat passengers sit.

clue.text: Missing the last word in a Shakespeare play

definitions.meaning: first meaning: gone, unable to be found

definitions.text: the last word in a Shakespeare play
definitions.note: a cryptic description, not a synonym
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the final word of the title Love's Labour's ...

explanation.surface: The final line of a Shakespeare play has gone astray.
explanation.walkthrough: The last word is in the play's title, not its text.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that cannot be found is gone, and that same word ends the title of a Shakespeare comedy.

clue.text: Architect in naval service

definitions.meaning: first meaning: Sir Christopher, designer of St Paul's Cathedral
second meaning: a member of the Women's Royal Naval Service

explanation.surface: A building designer who serves in the navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Christopher designed St Paul's, and members of the Women's Royal Naval Service were nicknamed thus.

clue.text: Arch beggar's' plea

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a pointed Gothic arch

definitions.note: a cryptic split: the cry O give!
definitions.meaning: second meaning: split as an imploring cry

explanation.surface: A cunning appeal from a beggar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arch' looks like the adjective meaning sly; it is the architectural noun.
explanation.definitionFit: In architecture a pointed arch or diagonal vault rib is called an ogive.

clue.text: Inspire one with _ honour, said you in this

parts.note: Roman numeral one

indicators.note: in this places one piece inside the rest of the wordplay

parts.note: Member of the Order of the British Empire, a British honour

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the word is replaced by a letter that sounds the same

parts.note: the letter U is pronounced like you

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about inspiring someone with an honour.
explanation.walkthrough: The MBE is a British honour; U goes between its B and E.
explanation.definitionFit: To imbue is to fill or permeate someone with a feeling, much as inspiring does.

clue.text: State representative to take the lead

definitions.meaning: first meaning: each ... on the US flag stands for one state
second meaning: to have the leading role in a show

explanation.surface: A state's elected representative stepping forward to lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State representative' suggests a politician; it is the emblem on the Stars and Stripes.
explanation.definitionFit: Each American state is symbolised on the flag, and a leading performer headlines a production.

clue.text: Order essential in the dictionary

indicators.note: essential means at the core, so the letters lie inside the following words

parts.note: letters spanning the two words

explanation.surface: Order is essential in a dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: An official decree issued by an authority is a command or order.

clue.text: Furniture for the sea-side concert party?

definitions.text: Furniture for the sea-side concert party?

parts.note: surface reading: a troupe performing a summer show at a seaside resort, often on the pier
setter's reading: an actual item of furniture whose name hints at the seaside

explanation.surface: Asking what furniture a seaside concert troupe would use.
explanation.walkthrough: The name actually refers to a table set against the wall between two windows, not the seaside.
explanation.definitionFit: A pier table is a narrow side table placed under a wall mirror between windows.

clue.text: New members on the field at Twickenham

definitions.note: a cryptic sense: its letters are three of the four compass points
definitions.meaning: first meaning: N, E and W are three of the four quarters of the compass

definitions.text: members on the field at Twickenham
definitions.meaning: second meaning: players in the rugby union back line

explanation.surface: Fresh players taking the pitch at England's rugby ground.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of New are three of the four compass points, quarters of the compass; Twickenham is the home of English rugby.
explanation.definitionFit: In rugby union the four backs between the halfbacks and the fullback hold these positions.
